# lcd.drawTriangle

<div class="api-badges"><span class="api-badge api-badge--since">since 1.5.5</span></div>

Draw a triangle.

```lua
lcd.drawTriangle(x1, y1, x2, y2, x3, y3)
```

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `x1` | number | yes | X1 coordinate |
| `y1` | number | yes | Y1 coordinate |
| `x2` | number | yes | X2 coordinate |
| `y2` | number | yes | Y2 coordinate |
| `x3` | number | yes | X3 coordinate |
| `y3` | number | yes | Y3 coordinate |

## Returns

Nothing.
